Drop-Ins

Need a quick resume review? Someone to review your LinkedIn profile briefly? Cover letter advice? Basic internship or job search questions? Or maybe you have a quick question about something career-related. Come see a Career Peer for a Drop-In!

What are Drop-Ins?

Drop-ins are 15-minute, in-person advising sessions for current students that do not require an appointment. Drop-in meetings are held at the Career Center (220 Mitten Hall). Students can also meet with Career Peers at Career Peer Pop-Ups, which are held at different locations across campus throughout the semester.  

Drop-in meetings are available on a first-come, first-served basis.

Who are Career Peers?

Temple University Career Peers are undergraduate students who are trained and ready to help Temple students with your next steps in your career path.  

What can I meet with a Career Peer about?

Common topics covered during drop-in sessions include: 

  • How the Career Center can help you 

  • Resume and cover letter reviews 

  • Job/internship search and application help 

  • LinkedIn profile reviews

Please note, Career Peers do not review Personal Statements, CVs, or grad school applications. Students must make appointments with Career Coaches for these topics.

Who can meet with a Career Peer?

All undergraduate and graduate students are welcome to use Drop-in services. 

When can I come for a Drop-In?

Drop-ins are available Monday through Friday during the Fall and Spring semesters.

Monday
9:15 am - 10:45 am
12:30 pm - 4:30 pm

9:30 am - 4:30 pm

3:00 pm - 4:30 pm

Please check Instagram (@templecareers) for day-of changes.
